Md Fazeel Ahmed E-mail: warrior7505@gmail.com ANAPLAN

DEVELOPER

Mobile: +91- 9347808725

PROFESSIONALSUMMARY:

 Overall 10 years of experience and 3+ years of relevant experience as an Anaplan

Model Builder.

 Understanding the client business process & business requirements.

 Design and Build Anaplan Application Models to Support Planning Process

 Anaplan Certified Model Builder

 Experience in Development,Testing and in making Production Models for the end users.

 Worked on User Access Management.

 Worked on Handling the Service Now tickets and providing the resolutions.

 Knowledge of Polaris, Workflow, Anaplan Data Orchestrator, Plan IQ, etc.

 Acquired knowledge on Anaplan Connect while working with Data Integration team.

 Data Validation and Data Governance using Data Hub.

 Worked with Various Lists like Flat lists, Composite Lists, ListSubset, DropdownLists

Lists Lists, Numbered List.

 Build, configure and maintain Anaplan Models with Use Cases like Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting, Performance Analysis & Sales Management.

 Knowledge on Workspace Management

 Good understanding of the Supply & Demand & Finance domain.

 Experience in Designing Modules with the Best Practices Method following PLANS

and DISCO etc.

 Worked on Various Functions Like Sum, Lookup, Timesum, Post, Offset, Isblank,

Isnotblank, FindITEM, Yearvalue, Etc.

 Created Reports: Country Sales RReports Margin Reports, Cost Reports, Profit &

Loss Reports, etc.

 Worked on EPM technology, End-to-end Implementation in the Projects.

 Monitor Data flows from financial systems to ensure all data is upto date and

accurate. Followed the best practices method.

TECHNICALSKILLS Cloud Tool- Anaplan Operating Systems: Basics of Windows,Unix, Linux, CCNA Softwares: AutoCAD,SAP2000.

AI Tools:

1. PowerBi, Excel using AI, AI Agents, Deepseek, Fiesta AI, Adobe Express, ChatGPT, ClaudeAI, Gemini Ai certified by Skill nation.

2. Data Analysis & coding using AI certified by Be10X. 3. AI & ChatGPT, Copilot, Gamma.app, etc. certified by Be10X.

CERTIFICATIONS

 Anaplan Level 3 in Progress  Anaplan Level2 Certified  Anaplan Level1 Certified  PowerBi certified by SkillNation  Data Analysis using AI certified by be10x  Excel using AI, AI & ChatGPT Certified by Be10X & Skill Nation  Mobile and Web Application development using AI by be10X  ISO Certified for AI by Freedom of AI  AutoCAD by Engineer’s CADD Centre  CCNA by PSF Skills Academy  Around 35 certifications for attending webinars & quizzes, during lockdown conducted by WHO

& various institutions.

PROJECT #1: USECASE: Distribution Resource Planning (Supply & Demand) (Support) Client: Tata Consultancy Services(TCS) (Oct'25 to Dec'25) (C2H) Payroll: (Zclus India Limited)/ ZEST Consulting Designation: Anaplan Developer.

Roles & Responsibilities:  To monitor the Service Now queue for Anaplan incidents.  Worked on handling Service Now Anaplan tickets and providing the resolution on

various issues related to Distribution Resource Planning.

Worked closely with the Client to give the updates & receive inputs on topics related to the tickets.

Worked on User Access Management by providing the appropriate access to the team members.

Assisted the team members in issues if they are stuck & also took helped each other to gain more knowledge.  Worked on Cloudworks.  Worked with cross-functional teams like Snowflake, Informatica, Boomi teams to ensure integration transmission done successfully to investigate Data discrepancy.  Interacted with various end users belonging to various countries like Spain, Japan, Portugal, etc., for understanding the ticket so as to provide the clear resolution.

PROJECT#2 USECASE: Financial Planning and Analysis.

Company: Edgerock Software Solutions Pvt.Ltd.(Since Feb'24 till Sep'25) Role: Anaplan Model Builder

Roles& Responsibilities:

 Understanding the new requirements of the model building  Managed the process of Development,Testing and Production with ALM.  Data, import, creation of import and delete Actions and creation of Processes  Provided security levels roles, selective access and DCA for the user access control.  By following PLANS, and DISCO, created the lists, modules UX pages

and, and also created actions.

 Worked on designing and building the model  Preparing Various types of reports like Operational, Financial, Revenue, Forecast etc.

PROJECT#3

USECASE: Sales and Ops Use case. Company:Edgerock Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd.(Since Aug'23 to Jan'24)

Role: Anaplan Model Builder

RolesandResponsibilities:

 Anaplan– S&OP Use Case:

 Built and optimized Anaplan models for demand forecasting and supply planning, aligning

operations with sales targets.

 Conducted scenario planning to evaluate the impact of, market variables on supply

chain operations.

 Developed models to optimize inventory, levels,, reducing excess stock and

enhancing efficiency.

 Facilitated collaboration between sales, operations, and finance teams,ensuring alignment on

S&OP plans.

 Generated interactive dashboards for real-time performance tracking and data-driven decision-

making

Previous Experience

PROJECT #4

Designation: Sr Associate Customer Support.

Company: Tech Mahindra (Jan'23 to Aug'23)

Project #5

Use Case: FP&A, Demand Planning and Supply Chain Management

Company: Anaplan: L1 & L2 Certification Program (May'21-Dec'22)

Through the Anaplan Level 1 Model Building (L1) certification, I gained foundational knowledge of Anaplan, including how to build modules, lists, line items, and dashboards. Learned to import and export data, apply basic formulas, and design simple yet effective planning models using the DISCO methodology. This level focused on core model-building skills and introduced structured thinking for scalable model design.

The Level 2 Model Building (L2) certification deepened my expertise by simulating real-world business scenarios across functions like FP&A, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain. I learned to create and maintain a centralized Data Hub, handle complex formulas, build dynamic reports, and apply best practices for model connectivity and data flow. L2 also introduced Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) concepts and emphasized performance optimization for large-scale models.



System Admin : DCET (July'18 - Sep'22)



Assistant Professor : DCET (Aug'14 to Jun'18)

EDUCATION

 ME from DCET, Osmania University, India 2015(71%)  BE from MJCET, Osmania University, India2013(73%)  Inter MPC from MNR Junior Kalasala, India, 2009(90%)  SSC from St Xavier School, India 2007(78%)
